name: mechanical-summarize
description: Shorten prose to a word budget by deleting words only. The skill tells the agent to keep the source's wording, order, claims, qualifications, and voice, and a bundled verifier checks that the copy is an ordered subsequence of the source and meets the word-count floor.

interface.shortDescription: Deletion-only compression by raw word count
interface.longDescription: Shorten prose to a word budget by deleting words only. The skill tells the agent to keep the source's wording, order, claims, qualifications, and voice, and a bundled verifier checks that the copy is an ordered subsequence of the source and meets the word-count floor.
defaultPrompt: Use $mechanical-summarize to create a 50% deletion-only copy of this document without changing its voice or claims.
